narrative: During this period, the contributor merged fewer pull requests while significantly increasing lines changed, shifting focus toward massive cleanup and refactoring efforts. Specifically, merged PR count dropped by 47.5 percent while total lines changed increased by 104.5 percent. This drop in throughput is explained by the transition to much larger, more complex tasks rather than a drop in overall activity.
root_cause_hypothesis: The shift to fewer but much larger pull requests explains the lower PR count and increased line volume.
